subtitle: The 90-Day English Drama

episodes.title: The Voice Note
episodes.situation: Macal records a fake-success voice note to his mother in Al Nahda, then takes a call from Dune & Co.
episodes.arc_beat: We meet Macal, his dream, his fear. He lies by omission.
episodes.phrases: greetings, introducing yourself, asking for repetition
episodes.cliffhanger: Caller: we need your two-minute video by Friday. Tarek texts: dont embarrass us.

episodes.title: Taxi to Deira
episodes.situation: Late for work, Macal takes a taxi driven by Ravi through Dubai traffic.
episodes.arc_beat: Macal must speak to be understood. He meets Nour at Dune & Co.
episodes.cliffhanger: He arrives late and sees Tarek charming the front desk.

episodes.title: The Coffee Order
episodes.situation: Macal buys coffee for Nour at Common Grounds; Aisha the barista helps him.
episodes.arc_beat: First real connection with Nour. He realizes he has been imitating British English.
episodes.cliffhanger: Nour: Im from Michigan, not London. Tarek posts a polished Rising Voices video.

episodes.title: The Complaint
episodes.situation: A client is furious about a double booking at Dune & Co.; Macal must de-escalate.
episodes.arc_beat: Macal stays calm and uses English under pressure.
episodes.cliffhanger: The client is Nours boss, who asks Macal to handle the follow-up call.

episodes.title: The Clause
episodes.situation: Macals landlord Mr. Qureshi raises the rent and mentions visa paperwork.
episodes.cliffhanger: Macals visa renewal depends on a full-time offer he doesnt have yet.

episodes.title: The Room
episodes.arc_beat: Macal joins conversations and pitches an idea; Tarek takes credit.
episodes.phrases: small talk, joining a group, follow-up
episodes.cliffhanger: Nours boss invites Macal to pitch at Rising Voices.

episodes.title: The Voice
episodes.situation: Macal records his Rising Voices video with Nours help.
episodes.arc_beat: Their connection deepens; he speaks from truth.
episodes.cliffhanger: Nours phone lights up with a Chicago offer; Macal sees it and says nothing.

episodes.title: The Mock
episodes.arc_beat: Rivalry cracks into honesty; Macals English sharpens.
episodes.phrases: interview answers, STAR method, clarifying questions
episodes.cliffhanger: Tarek admits his father is sick; Macals mother announces she is visiting Dubai.

episodes.title: The Pitch
episodes.situation: Macal pitches Macal Empire at Rising Voices.
episodes.arc_beat: He owns the room; Nour confesses she recommended him and may leave.
episodes.phrases: persuasive pitch, handling questions, buying time
episodes.cliffhanger: Judges announce tomorrow; Nour says she might go back to Chicago.

episodes.title: Two Worlds
episodes.situation: Final interview/offer day at Dune & Co.
episodes.arc_beat: Macal negotiates, tells the truth, and chooses his future.
episodes.cliffhanger: Macal gets the offer; Nour: Im staying if you want me to. Tarek asks to co-build a learning studio. End hook: a new voice message from a learner in Cairo.

story_so_far: Yalla Fluent, Season 1: In Dubai, Egyptian expat Macal has 90 days to turn his imperfect English into a real future - keep his job at Dune & Co., win the Rising Voices fellowship, and launch Macal Empire - amid a rivalry with polished Tarek, a growing connection with American-born Nour, and family back home who believe he already made it. Mahmoud (Egyptian-Arabic coach) breaks down the real English after each scene.
